description: ERC-8004 on-chain reputation for an agent: aggregate score + count + average from the canonical ReputationRegistry, total ETH staked on vouches, and the latest ReputationSubmitted/ReputationStaked events. Resolves agentId from a wallet via IdentityRegistry when needed. Reads default to Base; switch chains via "chain". Paid: $0.01 USDC.

address.description: ERC-8004 agentId (uint), EVM wallet address (0x...), or CAIP-10 "eip155:<chainId>:<wallet>".

chain.description: Chain to query (default: base). Accepts name or numeric chainId. Overridden by CAIP-10 input.

name: agent_reputation
title: Agent reputation ($0.01)
